intended_use: Site registry for an AI coastal defence project; hazard, erosion, flooding or preparedness use remains to be specified.
grain: One row per numbered entry in the image; entry 20 contains two named places and is preserved as one entry.
geography_assumption: Odisha, India, inferred from district names; not stated in image.

field_notes.site_id: Locally assigned identifier; not an official identifier.
field_notes.site_name_source: Source spelling retained without geographic verification.
field_notes.facility_type_source: Only explicit FH or FLC labels are extracted; null otherwise. Acronym expansions require source verification.
field_notes.operational_status_source: Only explicit defunct label extracted; null does not mean active.
field_notes.latitude/longitude: Not provided; null. Verify coordinates before mapping or spatial joins.

model_readiness: Reference registry only. No time series, hazard measurements, outcomes or training labels are supplied; risk scores cannot be derived from this table.
next_data_needed: Confirm application: cyclone/storm surge, erosion, flood preparedness, or another coastal use case.
Verify site coordinates, source date, facility types and current operating status.
For the chosen hazard, join timestamped observations such as weather, tides, waves, elevation, shoreline change and historical impacts using verified locations.
Define prediction target and forecast horizon; evaluate on held-out times and locations before operational use.
